history.text: Write a highly detailed, descriptive prompt of this image in English for an AI text-to-image generator (such as Midjourney, DALL-E, or Stable Diffusion). Describe the objects, background, style, lighting, color palette, and mood in detail. Do NOT include any introductory or concluding conversational text. Do not say 'Here is the prompt' or similar. Output ONLY the raw description of the image.

A young man with dark, styled hair and glasses stands in a room with vibrant lime green walls and a yellow floor. He is wearing a white t-shirt with a graphic design featuring pink lettering that reads "Super," followed by a stylized dragon or creature in black and pink, and the year "1997" in a circle with a registered trademark symbol. The t-shirt has a slightly oversized fit. He's also wearing wide-leg, dark-wash denim jeans that appear to have a gradient effect, darkening towards the bottom. White sneakers are visible on his feet.

To his left, a wall is covered in a lime green pegboard with various items hanging from it. These include a bright neon green folded bag and two transparent neon green bags, one of which has a grey cylindrical object with "loop line" written on it hanging inside.

The background features a tall, white, modern-looking appliance with vents at the top, possibly an air conditioner or purifier, which contrasts with the bright green walls. The lighting in the room is bright and even, casting soft shadows and highlighting the vivid colors of the environment. The overall mood is modern, urban, and youthful, with a strong emphasis on color and graphic design. The style is casual and trendy, suggesting a focus on streetwear fashion.
